name: Sun Bum
lead: Sun Bum is a beach-culture sun care and hair care brand whose sunscreens, lip balms and after-sun products are used to protect skin from UV exposure, which supports an even tone and a younger-looking complexion over time.[1] Its tagline is "Trust The Bum", and the brand presents its products as made for people who spend long hours in strong sun, such as surfers.[1]

The range includes Original, Mineral, Daily, Kids and Baby Bum sunscreens, SPF lip balms, tanning oils and lotions, after-sun care, and a hair care line. The brand's signature strength is SPF 30, with SPF 50 options also offered, including sprays.[1]

Sunscreen as a category is associated with prevention of sunburn and, with regular broad-spectrum use, with less visible photoaging such as wrinkles and dark spots.[2] Within looksmaxxing, sunscreen is commonly discussed as a base habit for skin quality, and Sun Bum is one of the recognizable brands people mention.

angle.text: Sun Bum products place a UV filter layer on the skin so people can tan or spend time outdoors with less burning. Over time, regular sunscreen use is linked to smoother, more even skin.

card.summary: Surf-culture sunscreen brand whose SPF products protect skin from burning and help keep complexion even and youthful-looking.
card.note: Sunscreen protection depends on applying enough and reapplying; label directions apply.

quick.overview:
Sun Bum makes sunscreens, lip balms, tanning products, after-sun care and hair care aimed at beach and outdoor users. Its signature SPF is 30, with higher options available.

People use it to keep skin from burning while getting sun, and many looksmaxxers treat daily sunscreen as a foundation for even, younger-looking skin.
quick.mechanism: Sunscreens use mineral filters such as zinc oxide or titanium dioxide, or organic chemical filters, to absorb or scatter UV light before it reaches the skin. SPF rates protection against burning UVB; broad-spectrum labels indicate UVA coverage as well.[2]
quick.risks: General sunscreen guidance is to apply generously and reapply about every two hours and after swimming. Products vary in ingredients, and the brand lists a mineral line for people who prefer zinc oxide or titanium dioxide filters.

paras: The brand's site lists sun care collections (Original, Mineral, Daily, Kids, Baby Bum, Signature), after-sun care and tanning oils and lotions, along with lip care and a hair care range, plus travel sizes and kits.[1] The Original Sunscreen is described by the brand as the formula that started the company.[1]

SPF indicates how much burning UVB radiation reaches the skin under standard application, and broad-spectrum labelling is meant to indicate UVA protection too. Mineral filters mainly absorb UV with some scattering, while chemical filters absorb UV and release it as heat. Guidance is to reapply roughly every two hours and after swimming, since most people apply less than the tested amount.[2]

Sunscreen is discussed as protecting skin tone and texture, and tanning-oriented users pair SPF with tanning products to build color more gradually. Daily sunscreen use has been associated in published studies with smoother skin and reversal of some photoaging signs.[2]
The brand's site links to a page on compliance with Hawaii's reef-related sunscreen law and to a nonprofit, Protect The Groms.[1]
No studies found on Sun Bum products specifically. Studies of daily sunscreen use in general are summarized in the Sunscreen article.[2]
